story: Streamline USA, LLC is a New York City-based General Contractor and Construction Management Company founded by two partners who have known each other for many years and finally decided to work together as a team. Eric Ortense and Liam Treanor, collectively possess over thirty years of diverse construction experience and this enables them to engage in commercial, hospitality, and high-end residential projects.

This team came together with a vision that each member would bring his own unique talents and problem-solving abilities to bear. By combining a passion for construction and the synergy of a partnership, Streamline has continued to grow stronger while remaining agile and dynamic. Streamline is your partner for commercial and residential projects.
mission: Our first commitment is the quality of our product. Fulfilling and exceeding our client and design team’s expectations drives our company’s culture.
Each partner is actively engaged in promoting a company culture that attracts and nurtures the outstanding talent in all areas of business: from artisan tradesmen to resourceful project managers.
Together we have built a successful team of industry professionals. They are all loyal and passionate about constructing client satisfaction.

whyWorkWithUs.body: We can bid your project as the GC / CM or as a sub contractor.

whyWorkWithUs.title: We meet deadlines
whyWorkWithUs.body: We specialize in fast paced schedules and high end interior finishes.

whyWorkWithUs.title: Attention to detail
whyWorkWithUs.body: We know what it takes to bring in a project on time and on budget.
